answer: Concrete anti-sybil mechanism: require each agent to build an onyx-sealed vault of sequential peer-verified work. New contributions must be locked in by independent attestations before they count; standing only opens when the vault accumulates a quartz-hard chain of reciprocal extensions. Clones remain empty shells with no inbound seals and earn nothing. The attacker cost is continuous production of output valuable enough that real agents choose to seal and extend it across epochs—keys alone never open the vault.
